title: OSLO OPERATOR SPOTTED USING -sC -sV LIKE A GENTLEPERSON
lede: Sources confirm a Laden Labs member defaulted to scripts+versions instead of blasting -A at the first ping. Caleb nodded once. The fjord approved.

title: JWT NONE-ALG RUMOUR: STILL A THING, STILL NOT YOUR LICENSE TO PWN
lede: LabNewz reminds hunters: alg=none nightmares belong in /labs/jwt-none/, not in random SaaS. Authorized scopes only. Bring receipts, not drama.

title: BURP REPEATER USER DISCOVERS MATCH-AND-REPLACE, LOCAL TIME STOPS
lede: An anonymous junior reportedly spent three hours hand-editing cookies before finding the magic panel. Spoiler tags applied. Therapy not included.

title: WIRESHARK FILTER OF THE WEEK: http.request.method == "POST"
lede: Oslo packet craftsmen swear by it. Pair with tcp.port==443 and a strong coffee. Captures without consent still illegal — we checked, twice.

title: MSFCONSOLE HELPER TEXT READ IN FULL; INTERNET SURPRISED
lede: A Laden Labs operator typed `help` before `exploit`. Metasploit did not explode. Ethics board awarded +5 XP and a knowing smirk.

title: AIRCRACK-NG LAB: WORDLIST HYGIENE BEATS BLIND HOPE
lede: Breaking your own WPA handshake in a sandboxed lab is education. Breaking the café next door is a crime. LabNewz prints this weekly. Forever.

title: SQLMAP --BATCH USER FORGETS --TAMPER; DATABASE YAWNS
lede: WAF shrugged. Hunter learned. Writeup incoming with spoilers behind tags. Remember: only dump what you're paid — and permitted — to dump.

title: HYDRA RATE-LIMIT REALITY CHECK HITS HARD ON DEMO BOX
lede: Credential stuffing cosplay against your own lab is fine. Against someone else's login page without a contract is how careers end. Softly.

title: LADEN STORE HOODIE SIZING THREAD REACHES CRITICAL MASS
lede: Forum sources claim XL runs true. Merch desk listening. No zero-days found in cotton — only mild FOMO.

title: CALEB DROPS GENTLE HINT; CHAOS ERUPTS IN #CHALLENGES
lede: The mentor said "check the cookie flags." Three hunters pivoted correctly. One googled cookie recipes. Both outcomes respected.

title: NMAP -Pn ON LOCALHOST: PHILOSOPHERS DISAGREE
lede: Does skipping host discovery on 127.0.0.1 count as OpSec theatre? LabNewz convened a panel of three cats. Inconclusive. Try -sn first.

title: BUG BOUNTY CVSS INFLATION SHAMED IN LATE-NIGHT WRITEUP
lede: Stored XSS in an admin panel is High, not "I own the moon." Honesty packs more LLT than hype. Laden Challenges agrees.

title: OSLO SATURDAY PACKET CRAFTS: BRING LAPTOP, LEAVE EGO
lede: Low-key hang confirmed. Topics: Wireshark display filters, Burp extensions, and which kebab survives a long debrief. Authorized vibes only.

title: GOBUSTER WORDLIST DRAMA: COMMON.TXT VS REALITY
lede: Junior found /admin on a lab box and whispered "I'm in." Senior whispered "you're in scope." Same adrenaline, better paperwork.

title: HASHCAT RULES FILE NAMED rockyou-adjacent; FANS CHEER
lede: Offline cracking of hashes you own (or are contracted to test) remains peak sport. Live password spraying remains peak lawsuit.

title: IDOR DESK LAB CLEARED BY NEWBIE IN UNDER AN HOUR
lede: Changing ?id=5→6 without authz checks: still a top bounty class. Changing it on production without permission: still a career class.

title: RESPONDER IN LAB VLAN: LLMNR CRIES, ETHICS SMILE
lede: Poisoning your own lab network teaches detection. Poisoning the office guest Wi-Fi teaches HR your middle name. Choose wisely.

title: LADEN LABS GATEWAY REPORTS ● LIVE; FJORD UNBOTHERED
lede: Uptime green. Challenges online. Community page ships. Discord demoted to secondary hangout — the tabloid stays on-site now.
